about:
Sunbelt Packaging LLC began in 1980 in York, South Carolina, as a supplier of specialty products for niche applications in the textile industry. The company expanded into flexible packaging materials to leverage its service reputation and grew through acquisitions into a global provider. Today it operates as part of BradyPLUS Company, a larger platform offering tailored solutions for janitorial/sanitation, foodservice, and industrial packaging markets.

The firm supplies a range of flexible packaging materials including flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBC), stretch films, shrink wrap, and strapping. It also sells and supports automated packaging equipment such as stretch wrappers, automatic strapping machines, palletizing robots with payloads from 6 kg to 1,200 kg, and continuous-motion wraparound case packers. Sunbelt services customers across all 50 U.S. states, Canada, Mexico, South America, and Singapore.

Its customer base spans manufacturing and distribution operations, with specific focus on the JanSan, foodservice, and industrial packaging sectors. The company’s heritage in textiles informs its approach to niche applications, while its current portfolio addresses broad packaging needs for industrial and consumer goods producers.

Sunbelt emphasizes its broad product offering, deep technical knowledge, and unique sourcing capabilities as the foundation of a customer-service-first culture. The leadership frames continuous improvement and reinvestment as the path to secure long-term partnerships, positioning the company as a supplier that aligns with growth-oriented customers.
